name: spc
description: Codex skill for safe, typed use of the SPC CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Use the SPC CLI for verified open-access papers and public research data.
interface.longDescription: Selects SPC CLI commands for paper search and lookup, verified open-access PDF download, local PDF parsing, Seed Pack updates, jobs, and supported public dataset archives.
defaultPrompt: Check whether SPC is ready for this research task.
Add these identifiers to an existing Seed Pack safely.
Parse this local PDF without treating it as official paper fulltext.
Download and verify the open-access PDF for this DOI.
Inspect a supported public archive after checking live capabilities.
